name: Paint World
description: Walking through a sunflower field, brush strokes repaint the world around the subject as a living oil painting.

wardrobe.man: a straw hat, a loose blue linen shirt and light trousers
wardrobe.woman: a straw hat, a loose blue linen shirt and light trousers
wardrobe.person: a straw hat, a loose blue linen shirt and light trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} walks toward the camera along a narrow dirt path through a huge sunflower field at golden hour, mid-stride, wearing {wardrobe}. Sunflowers stand shoulder high on both sides, a lone cypress tree and a small stone farmhouse sit on a hill behind, and wispy clouds stretch across a deep blue sky. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered, the path leading into the distance. Cinematic photography, warm golden backlight from the low sun on the left, rich yellow and blue tones. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, an unmarked farmhouse and a clean sky throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY walks along the path toward the camera, eyes on a point just past the camera. Thick visible brush strokes sweep across the frame and repaint the world as a living oil painting: the sky turns into swirling strokes of blue and white paint, the sunflowers into thick daubs of yellow and ochre impasto, the hill and the cypress into curling dark brushwork, all the strokes slowly moving and swirling, and finally the {subject} too is painted in thick strokes while {their} face stays recognisable, so that by the last second the whole scene is a moving post-impressionist painting. The camera dollies backward at walking pace. Sound: the soft swish of brushes on canvas, wind in the sunflowers, a warm summer buzz of insects. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, thick moving impasto oil paint, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. Thick visible brush strokes sweep across the frame and repaint the world as a living oil painting: the sky turns into swirling strokes of paint, everything around the {subject} into thick daubs of impasto, all the strokes slowly moving, and finally the {subject} too is painted in thick strokes while {their} face stays recognisable. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: the soft swish of brushes on canvas, a gentle breeze. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, thick moving impasto oil paint, sharp detail, stable picture.
